name: pyarchtrace
description: Source-grounded architecture, sequence, and flow diagrams for Python codebases.

interface.longDescription: Analyze Python source code and map its modules, layers, dependencies, and request paths into interactive architecture, sequence, and flow diagrams. Review the proposed structure before rendering. Explore module drill-downs, reposition nodes, and export SVG or PNG. Requires Python 3.10+ and the PyArchTrace CLI; diagram labels are Chinese by default.
defaultPrompt: Map this Python codebase with PyArchTrace. Show its layers and main path for review before rendering an interactive diagram.

zh-CN.subtitle: Python 项目架构图
zh-CN.description: 基于 Python 源码证据梳理模块、分层、依赖与请求路径，生成可交互的架构图、时序图和链路图。结构经用户确认后再渲染；支持模块下钻、拖动以及 SVG、PNG 导出。需要 Python 3.10+ 和 PyArchTrace 命令行工具，图中标签默认使用中文。
